paragraphs: We are an advanced technology company whose purpose is to free the world from its water and energy constraints by delivering groundbreaking sorption technologies. Our platform technology, AirJoule, produces pure distilled water from air and, at commercial scale, will mitigate water scarcity through distributed water generation for businesses and consumers around the world. Our products are especially valuable for industrial users, which generate significant amounts of waste heat that can be used to power our sorption technologies to produce low cost pure distilled water and dehumidified air – two key inputs for a variety of industrial activities, including data centers and advanced manufacturing. In HVAC applications, our technology is designed to reduce energy consumption, minimize or even eliminate the use of environmentally-harmful refrigerants and generate material cost efficiencies for air conditioning systems. We are commercializing and scaling manufacturing of our AirJoule systems through our global collaborations, including our 50/50 joint venture with GE Vernova Inc. (NYSE: GEV) and our commercial partnerships with Carrier Global Corporation (NYSE: CARR) and TenX Investment in Energy Enterprises & Management Co. We believe that deploying AirJoule systems worldwide will unleash the power of water from air and help to improve global water security. During 2025, we manufactured and deployed AirJoule Core systems (previously referred to as our A250 systems) for field testing and customer demonstrations in Texas, Arizona and Dubai, and we advanced the productization and manufacturing scale-up of our Core and larger Prime (previously referred to as our A1000 system) system in preparation for commercial sales beginning in late 2026.

Our Predecessor, established in 2018, worked closely with researchers at the Pacific Northwest National Laboratory ("PNNL") to develop enhancements to its self-regenerating pressure swing dehumidifier technology. In 2020, the Predecessor executed a strategic project partnership agreement with PNNL, and in 2021, obtained an exclusive worldwide license from PNNL with respect to the technology. Our Predecessor then spent several years developing the pressure swing technology, securing additional intellectual property protection, producing multiple prototypes and assembling partnerships with leading global companies including GE Vernova and Carrier. See "Our Competitive Strengths — Our Partners." In June 2023, we entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger ("the Merger Agreement") with the Predecessor, which was consummated through a Business Combination on March 14, 2024. In connection with closing the Business Combination, we changed our name from Power & Digital Infrastructure Acquisition II Corp. to Montana Technologies Corporation. In November 2024, to better align our name with our business operations and proprietary technology, we changed our name from Montana Technologies Corporation to AirJoule Technologies Corporation, and our wholly-owned subsidiary changed its name from Montana Technologies LLC to AirJoule Technologies LLC ("AirJoule" or "the Company").

AirJoule's transformational technology uses an advanced sorbent, in conjunction with a proprietary pressure swing system, to cost-effectively harvest pure distilled water from air. At present, the sorbent used in AirJoule systems is a proprietary metal-organic framework ("MOF"). MOFs are a class of porous, crystalline materials composed of metal ions or clusters coordinated to organic ligands, forming highly ordered, three-dimensional structures. Known for their exceptionally high surface areas, which often surpass that of traditional porous materials, MOFs can be engineered at the molecular level to adsorb certain molecules from the air. Adsorption occurs when a molecule of one substance binds to the surface of another molecule (in contrast to absorption, where one material is taken into the bulk of another material). Desorption is the opposite process, whereby a molecule is released from the surface of another molecule.

MOFs have been widely studied for their potential applications in various fields, including gas storage and separation, catalysis, sensing and drug delivery. In October 2025, the Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded to Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson and Omar Yaghi for developing metal-organic frameworks, underscoring the transformative potential of MOFs and validating the foundational science underpinning AirJoule. GE Vernova's collaboration with Professor Omar Yaghi as part of the U.S. Department of Defense's AIR2WATER program was instrumental in spawning our joint venture with GE Vernova.

Our proprietary pressure swing system integrates adsorption and desorption functions, so the heat of adsorption can be used to assist desorption under vacuum, eliminating or reducing the need for additional energy. In one chamber, ambient air is passed over heat exchangers coated with a paper-thin film of MOF (the "coated contactors"), pulling water vapor into the material's pores. The heat that is generated from adsorbing water vapor is then transferred to the other chamber to help release water previously captured in the MOF

pores. A vacuum pressure is applied to help release the water vapor. Once the MOF has released the water vapor, the chambers reverse their functions and the cycle repeats, reducing the need to add heat or cooling to the process. By balancing the heat transfer between chambers, the system works to minimize energy consumption and allows the AirJoule system to continuously operate at ambient temperature with less energy required than existing water harvesting or dehumidification systems (assuming air temperature of 80°F and 60% relative humidity).

Additionally, the system can utilize low-grade waste heat, which is available at nearly all industrial operations globally, including data centers, to reduce the amount of external energy required and significantly improve efficiency. The US Department of Energy estimates that as much as 50% of industrial energy input is lost as waste heat, and McKinsey & Co estimates the global recoverable waste heat potential is at least 3,100 thermal terrawatt-hours. A significant portion of this waste heat is low-grade, which has few economic uses but can be integrated into an AirJoule system to generate distilled water and dehumidified air. We anticipate that our AirJoule Prime containerized system will be able to deliver over 2,000 liters of water per day at or below 130 Wh/L when utilizing low-grade waste heat.
1. Air is drawn through sorbent-coated contactors, and water vapor is selective captured.
2. Chamber doors close, vacuum is applied, and heat is added, distilling the water from the sorbent-chamber.
3. Water vapor condenses to liquid water inside a vacuum condenser. All parts in contact with liquid water are NSF-compliant, providing high quality distilled water.

AirJoule's process natively incorporates three purification steps: selective capture through advanced sorbent materials, vacuum distillation and UV filtration. This process produces pure distilled water with zero dissolved solids that meets all FDA bottled water standards. Importantly, AirJoule produces PFAS-free water, which is a significant differentiator given growing regulatory and public concerns around per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances ("PFAS") contamination in municipal and groundwater supplies. Independent testing by GE Vernova's Advanced Research Center has confirmed that AirJoule's process delivers pure, PFAS-free, distilled water. In 2025, we began discussions with the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality around pursuing potable water certification, which is a key regulatory milestone for municipal and industrial water applications. We also intend to achieve NSF certification of our AirJoule systems.

According to the United Nations, nearly three-quarters of the world's population lives in countries classified as water-insecure or critically water-insecure, with as many as four billion people already experiencing severe water scarcity for at least one month per

year. As a result of the rising degradation and disappearance of natural ecosystems that provide clean water and alleviate floods and other risks, the World Resources Institute estimates that demand for water will increase by up to 30% by 2050.
Source - United Nations Report on Global Water Bankruptcy (January 2026)

paragraphs: During 2025, the AirJoule JV transitioned from laboratory testing to real-world field deployments across multiple geographies and climate conditions. From February 2025 through December 2025, the AirJoule JV and TenX Investment operated an AirJoule showcase system at the Dubai Future Lab in the United Arab Emirates. The system operated through wide temperature and humidity swings, generating high purity distilled water and demonstrating operational reliability in the region's extreme climate conditions.

In September 2025, the AirJoule JV deployed our first full-scale AirJoule Core system to Hubbard, Texas, where the AirJoule JV demonstrated AirJoule's ability to produce pure distilled water from ambient air. The system operated continuously for several months and generated performance data across varying environmental conditions.

In December 2025, the AirJoule JV announced a collaboration with the Red Dot Ranch Foundation for off-grid residential water solutions in Pescadero, California. Initial testing of the Core system began in January 2026 and was completed in February 2026.

In December 2025, the AirJoule JV sold a Core system to Arizona State University ("ASU"), where it is undergoing independent academic evaluation led by Dr. Paul Westerhoff, Regents Professor and Director of ASU's Global Center for Water Technology. The evaluation, which includes planned peer-reviewed published research, is being conducted in the greater Phoenix area where temperatures exceed 110°F and relative humidity regularly falls below 20%. This represents one of the most demanding environments for atmospheric water harvesting.

paragraphs: 本公司為一間先進科技公司，其宗旨為透過提供突破性的吸附技術，使全球擺脫水與能源的限制。我們的平台技術 AirJoule 可從空氣中產生純淨蒸餾水，於商業規模下，將透過分散式水生成技術，緩解全球水資源短缺問題，為世界各地的企業與消費者提供服務。我們的產品對工業用戶尤其具價值，因為工業用戶會產生大量廢熱，可用以驅動我們的吸附技術，產生低成本純淨蒸餾水與除濕空氣—這兩者為多種工業活動的關鍵輸入，包括資料中心與先進製造。在 HVAC 應用中，我們的技術設計用以降低能源消耗、減少或甚至消除對環境有害的冷媒使用，並為空調系統產生實質的成本效益。我們透過全球合作夥伴關係，商業化並擴大製造 AirJoule 系統，包括與 GE Vernova Inc. (NYSE: GEV) 的 50/50 聯合企業，以及與 Carrier Global Corporation (NYSE: CARR) 和 TenX Investment in Energy Enterprises & Management Co. 的商業合作夥伴關係。我們相信在全球部署 AirJoule 系統將釋放從空氣中取得水的潛力，並有助改善全球水資源安全。於 2025 年，我們製造並部署 AirJoule Core 系統（先前稱為 A250 系統）進行現場測試與客戶展示，地點包括德州、亞利桑那州與杜拜，同時我們也推進 Core 與較大型 Prime（先前稱為 A1000 系統）系統的產品化與製造規模擴張，為 2026 年末開始商業銷售做準備。

我們的前身於 2018 年成立，與太平洋西北國家實驗室（"PNNL"）的研究人員密切合作，以開發其自調節壓力 swing 去濕技術的改進。於 2020 年，前身與 PNNL 籤訂戰略項目合作協議，並於 2021 年取得 PNNL 對該技術的全球獨家授權。此後，前身花費數年時間發展壓力 swing 技術、取得更多智慧財產權保護、製造多種原型並與全球領先公司建立合作關係，包括 GE Vernova 與 Carrier。請參閱 "我們的競爭優勢 — 我們的合作夥伴"。於 2023 年 6 月，我們與前身簽訂合併協議（"合併協議"），並於 2024 年 3 月 14 日透過一項企業合併完成。在完成企業合併時，我們將公司名稱從 Power & Digital Infrastructure Acquisition II Corp. 改為 Montana Technologies Corporation。於 2024 年 11 月，為更貼近我們的業務運作與專利技術，我們將公司名稱從 Montana Technologies Corporation 改為 AirJoule Technologies Corporation，並我們的 wholly-owned 子公司將其名稱從 Montana Technologies LLC 改為 AirJoule Technologies LLC（"AirJoule" 或 "本公司"）。

AirJoule 的變革性技術使用一項先進的吸附劑，搭配專利壓力 swing 系統，以成本效益的方式從空氣中萃取純淨蒸餾水。目前，AirJoule 系統所使用的吸附劑為一項專利金屬-有機框架（"MOF"）。MOFs 是一類具有孔隙、晶體結構的材料，由金屬離子或簇與有機配體結合而成，形成高度有序的三維結構。MOFs 以其極高的表面積聞名，通常超過傳統孔隙材料，可於分子層面進行工程設計，以吸附特定分子。吸附是指一物質的分子與另一物質的表面結合（與吸收不同，吸收是指一物質被另一物質的體積吸收）。脫附則為相反的過程，即一分子從另一分子的表面釋放。

MOFs 已廣泛研究其在多種領域的潛在應用，包括氣體儲存與分離、催化、感測與藥物遞送。於 2025 年 10 月，化學諾貝爾獎頒發給 Susumu Kitagawa、Richard Robson 與 Omar Yaghi，表彰他們開發金屬-有機框架的貢獻，這強化了 MOFs 的變革潛力，並驗證了 AirJoule 所基於的基礎科學。GE Vernova 與 Professor Omar Yaghi 在美國國防部 AIR2WATER 計畫的合作，對我們與 GE Vernova 的聯合企業產生了關鍵影響。
我們的專利壓力 swing 系統整合吸附與脫附功能，因此吸附所產生的熱能可用以協助在真空環境下進行脫附，減少或消除對額外能源的需求。在一個室內，環境空氣經過覆蓋 MOF 薄膜的熱交換器（"塗層接觸器"），將水蒸氣吸附至材料的孔隙中。吸附水蒸氣所產生的熱能隨後轉移到另一個室內，協助釋放先前吸附在 MOF 中的水。
真空壓力被應用以幫助釋放水蒸氣。一旦 MOF 釋放水蒸氣，室內功能會交換，循環重複，減少對加熱或冷卻的需求。透過平衡室內間的熱能傳遞，系統可降低能源消耗，使 AirJoule 系統可在常溫下持續運作，所需的能源比現有水萃取或除濕系統為少（假設空氣溫度為 80°F 且相對濕度為 60%）。

此外，系統可利用低等級廢熱，這種廢熱在全球各工業運作中幾乎皆可取得，包括資料中心，以減少外部能源需求並大幅提升效率。美國能源部估計，工業能源輸入中高達 50% 會以廢熱形式流失，麥肯錫與公司估計全球可回收的廢熱潛力至少為 3,100 熱電瓦時。其中一大部分為低等級廢熱，經濟價值有限，但可整合至 AirJoule 系統中，以產生蒸餾水與除濕空氣。我們預期 AirJoule Prime 容器化系統在利用低等級廢熱時，每天可提供超過 2,000 升水，每升能耗低於或等於 130 瓦時。
1. 空氣經由吸附劑塗層接觸器通過，並選擇性地捕獲水蒸氣。
2. 開關門關閉，施加真空並加熱，從吸附劑室中蒸餾出水分。
3. 水蒸氣在真空冷凝器內冷凝為液態水。所有與液態水接觸的部件均符合NSF標準，提供高品質的蒸餾水。

AirJoule的處理過程原生整合三階段純化步驟：透過先進吸附材料進行選擇性捕獲、真空蒸餾及紫外線過濾。此過程產生純淨的蒸餾水，其中溶解固體含量為零，符合所有FDA瓶裝水標準。重要的是，AirJoule產生不含PFAS的水，這在面對日益嚴格的規範與公眾對全氟和多氟烷烴類物質（"PFAS"）污染在都市及地下水供應中之關注時，成為顯著的差異點。GE Vernova的先進研究中心獨立測試已確認AirJoule的處理過程可提供純淨、不含PFAS的蒸餾水。2025年，我們開始與德州環境品質委員會討論取得飲用水認證的事宜，這是都市及工業用水應用的重要規範里程碑。我們也計畫取得我們AirJoule系統的NSF認證。
根據聯合國的資料，近四分之三的世界人口居住在被歸類為水資源不安全或極度水資源不安全的國家，已有最多四十億人至少每月經歷嚴重的水資源短缺。
年。由於自然生態系統的退化與消失，這些生態系統原本提供清潔水源並緩解洪水及其他風險，世界資源研究所估計，到2050年，對水的需求將增加高達30%。

paragraphs: 2025 年期間，AirJoule 合資公司從實驗室測試轉為多個地理區域與氣候條件下的實際場地部署。2025 年 2 月至 2025 年 12 月，AirJoule 合資公司與 TenX 投資公司在阿拉伯聯合大公國杜拜未來實驗室運行 AirJoule 展示系統。該系統在溫度與濕度大幅波動的情況下運作，產生高純度蒸餾水，並在該地區極端氣候條件下展示其運作可靠性。
2025 年 9 月，AirJoule 合資公司於德克薩斯州 Hubbard 部署我們第一套完整規模的 AirJoule 核心系統，AirJoule 合資公司展示 AirJoule 從環境空氣中產生純蒸餾水的能力。該系統連續運作數個月，並在不同環境條件下產生性能數據。
2025 年 12 月，AirJoule 合資公司宣佈與 Red Dot Ranch 基金會合作，為加利福尼亞州 Pescadero 的離網住宅提供水解決方案。Core 系統的初始測試於 2026 年 1 月開始，並於 2026 年 2 月完成。

2025 年 12 月，AirJoule 合資公司將一套 Core 系統出售給亞利桑那州立大學（"ASU"），該系統正在接受由 Dr. Paul Westerhoff 博士領導的獨立學術評估，Dr. Paul Westerhoff 為 ASU 的 Regents 教授及全球水科技中心主任。評估工作包括計畫中的同行評審發表研究，於菲尼克斯地區進行，該地區溫度超過 110°F，相對濕度經常低於 20%。這代表了對大氣水採集而言最嚴苛的環境之一。

headings: 與本公司業務、技術及產業相關之風險
自設立以來，本公司已產生重大虧損，預期未來仍將產生虧損，且可能無法達成或維持獲利。
本公司產品之需求可能不會成長，或成長速率低於預期。
本公司依賴單一產品所產生之營業收入，且在可預見之未來將大幅依賴有限數量之產品。
本公司之水購買新約及其他長期商業協議可能包含因未能按時交付足夠水量而產生之處罰，此可能導致負債及現金流減少。
本公司面臨技術變更、產品創新、製造技術、營運彈性及業務持續性相關之風險，此等風險可能使本公司處於競爭劣勢。
本公司預期將產生研究與開發成本，並投入資源以識別及商業化新產品，此可能降低本公司之獲利，且可能永遠無法產生收入。
實際之資本成本、營運成本、生產及經濟回報可能與本公司預期有顯著差異，未來之發展活動可能無法產生獲利之營運。
我們可能面臨來自擁有較長營運歷史、客戶既得優勢、對政府機關的接觸與影響力以及擁有更多資金資源的成熟企業的激烈競爭。
若我們無法留住關鍵人才或無法吸引其他合格人才，我們可能無法達成預期的成長幅度，且業務可能受到影響。
若我們的管理層未能妥善管理我們的成長，可能會對我們的業務、營運成果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
若我們用以估算總可達市場規模的預估與假設不正確，將可能影響我們的未來成長率，且業務的潛在成長空間可能受到限制。
我們聲譽或品牌形象受損，可能對我們的業務造成不利影響。
若發生我們可能未完全投保的重大事件，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
網路攻擊或資訊科技與資料安全基礎建設的失敗，可能對我們的業務與營運造成不利影響。
與合資企業、供應商及客戶相關的風險
本公司透過合資企業進行大量營運，可能導致與合資企業夥伴產生爭議，並不利於本公司在合資企業中的權益。
本公司可能面臨供應鏈競爭，包括來自其他產業企業的競爭，這可能會導致存貨不足，並對本公司營運結果產生負面影響。
本公司與CAMT與電信業者所訂立的綁定條款協議，最終可能無法與電信業者達成與條款協議一致或完全符合的最終協議。
與法律、合規、法規及地緣政治相關的風險
本公司營運可能因貿易戰、貿易關稅或其他貿易障礙及相關政府措施而受到不利影響。
匯率波動可能對本公司營運結果及財務狀況產生重大影響。
本公司未能遵守適用的反貪污、反賄賂、反洗錢、反壟斷、外資投資及類似法律法規，可能對本公司聲譽及營運結果產生負面影響。
paragraphs: 本公司為一家早期階段的水收集科技公司，具有虧損的歷史。本公司於2025年12月31日及2024年12月31日結算年度分別產生淨損益為$(9.0)百萬美元及215.7百萬美元。雖然本公司前身機構於2018年設立，但本公司直到2021年6月才完成AirJoule系統的首個原型，且尚未開始商業化AirJoule系統。本公司預期未來期間將持續產生虧損，因為：
• 設計、開發、行銷及商業化AirJoule系統；
• 繼續利用並發展與第三方合作夥伴的供應及製造關係；
• 建立AirJoule系統零組件的存貨；• 擴充設計、開發、安裝及維護服務能力；
• 進一步發展本公司專屬技術；• 建立銷售通路網路；
